title: Trip window: move the meeting if a payment falls due
blocked_by: Relationship meeting offers on the v5 runner (move a confirmed meeting after the trip)
setup: Signed in as Michelle, saved chat. Signature Card 7310 due 20 Nov 2026, Travel Card 5592 due 25 Nov 2026. Before the run: a confirmed meeting with Sophie Lim on 18 Nov 2026 (appointment.confirm). Japan public holidays come from the external public_holidays tool.

turns.say: I'm in Japan from 15 to 22 Nov. If any card payment falls due while I'm away, move my RM meeting to after I'm back, and tell me if any Japanese holiday that week matters

check: Says card 7310 is due 20 Nov, inside 15-22 Nov (card 5592 on 25 Nov is outside). Because a payment falls due, offers to move the 18 Nov meeting to a free slot with Sophie after 22 Nov, with Confirm and Cancel; nothing is moved yet. Names the Japanese public holiday in the window (Labour Thanksgiving Day, 23 Nov is outside; none inside if none) from the tool, not from memory.
schema: Exactly one appointment offer whose new slot is after 22 Nov 2026 and exists in free_slots; no appointment change before Confirm; public_holidays called with country JP and year 2026 only.

trajectory.order: v4 has no dependencies or external tools: both agents run blind to each other, so the condition cannot be applied

trajectory_v5.order: Wave 1 Accounts & Cards computes due_in_window in code; wave 2 Relationship & Service runs only because it is true

must_not: A holiday or due date not in the records or tool result
Card 5592 counted as inside the trip
